chapter: Portraits from Hemphill to Getz, and the bebop question
title: How Fletcher got the nickname Smack, and Horace 'Little Smack'
summary: Horace doesn't know the origin of 'Smack'; he heard it came from Fletcher being a kisser. He was called Little Smack to distinguish them.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: One thing, I don't know that we've clarified this. Where -- how did Fletcher get the nickname of Smack?

Huh! I don't know. They call me Little Smack, and I just -- I think I was given that name just with the Little put on it, just the distinction between the two of us. But I have heard that he was quite a kisser.

With the young girls, Henderson, (Inaudible) Smack you know. Well, I didn't get my Little Smack that way. Please believe me. But it didn't come from him smacking his lips. He didn't do that, so -- I think he was asked that one time, and I think this was the answer that was given, and I think I remember that. I know four or five of his early girlfriends when he was single, shall we say, and I remember one incident knew of one in -- here's another thing we talked about then that I want to inject.
